coreTests.scope: The public repository core suite; no browser, GPU or SDK benchmark is implied by this test count. The local console log is not included because it contains machine paths.

reportManifest.scope: The report, figures and aggregates. The separate measurements manifest covers the sanitized evidence package.

rendererIdentity.difference: The published renderer removes optional Baidu dark-theme/custom-style initialization. The common-map renderer identity is preserved, not relabeled as the new full-file hash.

limitations: This publication does not rerun or replace the recorded performance trials.
Physical display FPS remains unavailable; browser presentation feedback and rAF telemetry are distinct.
The initial Baidu scene gate recorded 10 tile requests, 8 successful and 2 failed; the final cumulative network snapshot recorded 18 requests, 16 successful and 2 failed.
